versions.subject: Сreate win_susp_winrm_execution
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\cscript.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'winrm'
        - 'invoke Create wmicimv2/Win32_'
        - '-r:http'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\cscript.exe" CommandLine="*winrm*" CommandLine="*invoke Create wmicimv2/Win32_*" CommandLine="*-r:http*"
